title: The Curtain Opens — profiled test arrangement

tracks.name: One steel pan — written principal melody
tracks.program_path: $World Suite 3.ufs/Presets/01 Types/Metal & Gong/Steel Pan/Steel Pan Main.uvip

tracks.name: Nylon guitar — foreground dialogue; comp rests
Keys — written pre-chorus and bridge melody
Bass — chord roots, anticipations and phrase cadences
Percussion Factory — direct claves and shekere

sections.name: Curtain hook
sections.development: State a short recognizable pan opening with bass; do not start with a long percussion intro.
sections.handoff: Pan completes its pickup; congas enter at the verse.

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.development: Two written eight-bar sentences: plain theme, then a guitar/conga answer. Keys and guest rest.
sections.handoff: Leave the final phrase ending open for the pre-chorus.

sections.name: Pre-chorus 1
sections.development: Harmonic lift and reduced percussion make the chorus arrival clear.
sections.handoff: Keys release before the pan refrain; no overlapping fill.

sections.name: Chorus 1
sections.development: Full hook, wider chord body and a clear bass answer; preserve a single foreground.
sections.handoff: Reduce the producer layer and keys before Verse 2.

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.development: Change bass movement and exchange the answer between guitar and keys. The electronic kit rests.
sections.handoff: A short conga punctuation leads to the lift.

sections.name: Pre-chorus 2
sections.development: Repeat the recognizable lift with a different register and more space.
sections.handoff: Pan returns clearly on the next downbeat.

sections.name: Chorus 2
sections.development: Guest timbales supplies one written response; remove another subdivision so the song does not simply become louder.
sections.handoff: Pan finishes and rests for the bridge.

sections.name: Keys bridge
sections.development: A complete quieter keyboard sentence uses established material. Hand drums and pan rest.
sections.handoff: Keys end the sentence; guitar receives the next foreground.

sections.name: Band dialogue
sections.development: Guitar carries a written answer; pan returns only in its reserved reply. No open-ended solo.
sections.handoff: A clear cadence and short rest announce the final hook.

sections.name: Final chorus
sections.development: First eight bars state the hook plainly; the second eight develop response/register and a selected shaped pan roll.
sections.handoff: Thin the accompaniment before the final phrase resolves.

sections.name: Curtain close
sections.development: A written cadence and natural ring end the song.
sections.handoff: All rhythmic layers stop intentionally; preserve the tail.

references: DKC1 environmental contrast and motif memory; Bonobo ensemble production; performer-specific principles in the linked cue call sheet.
melody_adaptation: Original A/B pitches preserved; Sky 6/8 quarter-note phrasing expanded 4/3 into 4/4; Castle returns to original approved 3/4; Opera adds bounded cadence rolls.
mastering_plan: Measured part and group gain staging, native ReaEQ, quiet shared room, gentle 1.35:1 glue and measured album gain; native -2 dB peak guard; decoded OGG true-peak/DC/mono checks.
